name: PI Industries Ltd.
business_summary: Custom-synthesis and manufacturing (CSM) agchem and pharma-intermediates exporter for global innovators (notably Japanese and European crop-science companies) plus a domestic branded agri-inputs business and biologicals/Isagro (model knowledge). Q2 FY27: sales Rs1,702 cr (-9% y/y), OP Rs233 cr (OPM 14% vs 29%), PAT Rs122 cr (-70%). TTM sales -15%. Shares hit a 6-year low on 5 Nov (-15 to -18%) after a Morgan Stanley double downgrade (21 Oct) and a 'Kumiai warning' (11 Sep).

exposures.mechanism: Exports ~70% of revenue (model knowledge), USD-linked inputs ~25% of sales -> net long ~45% of sales; +3% -> +1.35% of sales -> EBITDA +6.8% at 20% TTM margin (more at the 14% Q2 margin); ~50% hedged near term -> +3.4%; x0.97 EV/MCap x persistence 0.5 -> +1.6; rounded +2.0. Not significant empirically.

SSU +10% global agrochemical molecule prices/volumes (destocking recovery). Custom-synthesis contracts are cost-plus but volumes/mix follow innovator off-take; +10% -> revenue +6% (CSM + domestic) -> EBITDA +20% at 14-20% margin x0.97 x persistence 0.5 -> +9.7; shaded to +6 because CSM contracts lag. Sales -16% in FY26 and TTM -15% show how large the destocking effect was.

evidence.note: Shares -15 to -18% to 6-year low on 5 Nov after Q2 profit -70% to Rs122 cr, margins nearly halve (Business Standard, NDTV Profit, BusinessLine, CNBC TV18); Morgan Stanley double downgrade 21 Oct; 'Kumiai warning' 11 Sep (content not retrieved)

exposures.mechanism: Chinese agchem intermediates/actives dumping (+15% export volumes/price cuts) cut generic-active prices and pressure CSM re-sourcing; +15% -> price -5% on ~35% of the portfolio -> EBITDA -8% x0.97 x0.5... -3.9; shaded to -3. Pack has no significant empirical beta.

Core investment thesis: innovators shift sourcing to India. +1 SSU = a step-up in new CSM molecule awards; every +Rs300 cr of annual orders ~ +4% sales. Valuation hit (stock -50% 12m) suggests thesis is being doubted.

US/EU-bound CSM contracts are typically priced FOB/ex-works with customer absorbing duty, but 10pp tariff reduces innovator margin and volume; US ~20% of exports (model estimate) -> volumes -2% -> EBITDA -3.5% x0.97 x0.5 -> -1.7; reduced for contract protection.
Domestic agri-inputs ~30% of sales (model); +10% monsoon above LPA -> kharif acreage and pest pressure up -> domestic sales +5% -> EBITDA +4% x0.5 -> +1.9; shaded.

Solvents, aromatics and intermediates ~45% of costs; CSM contracts pass through most raw-material moves with a 1-2 quarter lag (~70% pass-through). +10% -> costs +4.5% x30% unrecovered = +1.35% of costs -> EBITDA -4.7% at 20% margin... x0.5 -> -1.0 after lag.
European/Japanese innovator end-markets (cropland spend) set CSM order flow; +1pp growth -> +0.5% CSM volume -> small.
Domestic agri-input pull follows farm incomes; +5pp rural growth -> domestic sales +3% -> +1.0.

supply_chain.counterparty: Kumiai Chemical, Nissan Chemical, Corteva, Bayer and other innovators
supply_chain.note: concentrated multi-year CSM contracts; Kumiai warning 11 Sep
